protocol_metadata.artifact_selection: Select the first artifact by (artifact_id, path, sha256), independently of target error. Regression prefers KV warmup on.
protocol_metadata.coverage: MAPE averages absolute percentage errors over successful predictions. Coverage retains all eligible targets, including cold-start misses.
protocol_metadata.interpolation: Use the selected measured self-benchmark table and retain resolved native method diagnostics.

gbdt.label: GBDT
gbdt.offline_model: Fit the 150-tree, 15-leaf, learning-rate-0.2 fpm5 seed using AISim, then freeze it.
gbdt.online_update: AISim structural online GBDT with grouped history and a 64-observation FIFO per native store.

hybrid.label: GBDT + hybrid calibration
hybrid.online_update: Freeze the initial forest; AISim hybrid calibration consumes admitted C labels.

selector.label: GBDT + causal selector
selector.online_update: AISim selects between the stable hybrid-calibrated expert and the online GBDT using past paired errors.

mixed_fallback.gbdt: A uses raw composition. A+C uses calibrated composition and the native continuous quality checker with defaults alpha=0.05, min_comparisons=5.
mixed_fallback.hybrid: A+C calibrates interpolation for missing mixed stores and keeps forests frozen.
mixed_fallback.original_a: Source-bound self-benchmark manifest; never synthesized from B or C.
mixed_fallback.selector: A+C competes calibrated interpolation against a causally bootstrapped mixed forest.

protocol_metadata.null_results: Null denotes inapplicable methods; missing inputs or unsupported APIs retain an explicit status.
protocol_metadata.offline_model: A/B GBDT uses the same 150x15 seed recipe; evaluation labels are never admitted.
protocol_metadata.online_model: Models and native diagnostics use the evaluated AISim wheel. Bootstrap consumes only previously scored, scheduled observations; no local model or selector reimplementation.

online_schedule.description: Ticks begin five seconds after the first scored observation. Select the first observation at or after each elapsed tick; predict and score before admitting its label. Warmup uses exactly this schedule. Gaps skip ticks, ties consume a tick once, and there is no final flush or catch-up.

protocol_metadata.online_update_count: Successful native adapter tune calls; failed calls and submitted observations are counted separately.

a.description: Fit the self-benchmark, then score all target observations without updates.
a.label: A · Self-benchmark → frozen

ac.description: Seed from the self-benchmark, then score all targets with five-second online feedback.
ac.label: A + C · Self-benchmark → online

b.description: Train a deterministic fraction within each workload kind; freeze and score the disjoint remainder.
b.label: B · Distributed holdout

bc.description: Train on the chronological prefix; score the remainder with five-second online feedback.
bc.label: B + C · Temporal holdout → online

c.description: Start without offline data. Score every observation; admit one observation per five-second tick, including warmup.
c.label: C · Strict online cold start

split.b: Deterministic distributed holdout within each workload kind.

protocol_metadata.timing: Fit time covers preparation and initial model construction. Prediction/update times include complete adapter calls, including cold bootstrap and lazy fits. Event time is replayed without sleeping.
protocol_metadata.training_count: B/B+C count offline trace observations; A/A+C count self-benchmark inputs per target worker; strict C is zero.

baseline.timing_scope: Complete score_scenario call plus its fit/predict/update counters
